newsitem.title: IRAQ: Saddam to address Iraqi nation on Army Day.
newsitem.headline: Saddam to address Iraqi nation on Army Day.

text.p: President Saddam Hussein will deliver "a comprehensive, national and historic" speech on Monday to mark the 76th founding anniversary of the Iraqi armed forces, the official Iraqi News Agency (INA) reported on Sunday.
It said Saddam's address would be broadcast at 11 a.m. (0800 GMT) and "radio stations, television channels and INA will carry the speech directly via their internal and external networks."
